title: The Metabolic Year — a new measurement unit from feast-famine pi-sort

the_measurement.what: one METABOLIC YEAR = one complete feast-famine cycle. not calendar time. metabolic time.
the_measurement.duration: varies by organism. E.coli: 1 hour. human daily: 24 hours. membrane session: ~24 hours. bear: 365 days. tardigrade: 30+ years. lotus seed: 2000 years.
the_measurement.formula: 1 MY = feast_duration + famine_duration. the RATIO of fast/cycle is what matters, not the absolute time.
